title: Testing emotional reactions  in our AI NPC (Whispers from the Star)
author: WhispersfromtheStar

comments.author: WhispersfromtheStar
comments.body: Thanks for all the positive feedback you've given us on Whispers from the Star! If you still want to beta test, you can sign up at [https://wfts.anuttacon.com](https://wfts.anuttacon.com)

comments.author: RemyPrice
comments.body:
I love this project and I’ve been following the development.

Would it be out of line to give some feedback?

The responses are long monologues, several sentences long, and are perfect. Which is not really how people talk. We use short sentences, correct ourselves mid sentence, repeat ourselves, start a sentence over for clarity, say things like “hold on, wait, let me start over.”

The absence of these “verbal flubs” is going to be your uncanny valley.

replies.author: Inside_Anxiety6143
replies.body: Real humans talk like that, but typically in writing and in films, you get longer sentences and less errors. So it really comes down to if they are trying to simulate a real person, or if its meant to feel like you are inside a movie.

replies.author: WhispersfromtheStar
replies.body: This is really interesting feedback, thank you!

replies.author: RemyPrice
replies.body: Happy to help. Really looking forward to seeing this develop.
